<MethodEndpoint
  method={"post"}
  path={"/api/restore_instance"}
  context={"endpoint"}
>
  
</MethodEndpoint>



Replaces every setting, user, role, project, template group and
catalog subscription on this grid with what's in the remote instance
repository - see GIT.GITutils.restore_instance for what that actually
touches. A fully
destructive, one-shot action with no merge and no undo; the frontend is
expected to have the operator confirm that before this is ever called.

Authenticates the same way a backup push does (backup_ssh_key) rather
than with the acting user's own key - restoring the whole grid is an
instance-level operation, not a personal one.

Gated on SETTINGS_BACKUP at the table level (see AUTHpermissionMap.py);
also requires SETTINGS_SERVER here, since the restore is only actually
finished once the frontend's follow-up restart_grid call succeeds, and
that route needs SETTINGS_SERVER itself - the one role that can trigger
a restore should be guaranteed able to complete it.
